patch_description: Builds on the Gen-24 lineage's proven components (sparse CSR LP radii, slack-directed moves, Metropolis reheating) but restructures per the recommendations: (1) a much broader deduplicated candidate screen with boundary-dense row patterns ([6,5,5,5,6], [6,5,4,5,6], [6,5,6,5,4], etc.) plus vertical-axis mirrored variants and 3 scale factors each, screened cheaply with fast iterative-shrink radii before committing to expensive LP search; (2) multi-start hill-climb with per-start Metropolis acceptance and best-ever tracking on the top-screened basins only; (3) final exact-LP polish. Key insight: boundary clustering (6-count edge rows) leaves large corner gaps that LP radii can exploit with bigger corner circles, matching AlphaEvolve-level structure.
